verdict.rationale: Expensify's 'Ask Expensify AI Anything' lets users create, categorize, approve, and reject expenses via plain language, and fix workspace/rule setup by asking (docs-3, docs-4), showing some conversational policy interaction. However, there is no evidence of the AI proactively chasing missing receipts, explaining declined expenses, or answering pre-spend 'can I expense this?' questions before the transaction occurs. missing for 10: proactive receipt-chasing behavior, decline explanations, pre-spend policy Q&A, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of these conversational enforcement behaviors.
